text: 国银金租(01606.HK)在港交所公告，公司于2026年11月13日与广东数寰智联科技有限公司订立产品采购协议，拟以约9.81亿元人民币的总代价购买信息技术计算机设备。该代价将以公司自有资金及/或商业银行贷款支付。交易完成后，公司将作为出租人与第三方承租人签订经营租赁合同，将采购标的以经营租赁模式出租。
text_en: CDB Leasing (01606.HK) announced on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange that on November 13, 2026, the company entered into a product procurement agreement with Guangdong Shuhuan Zhilian Technology Co., Ltd., intending to purchase information technology computer equipment at a total consideration of approximately RMB 981 million. The consideration will be paid with the company's own funds and/or commercial bank loans. After the transaction is completed, the company will, as lessor, sign operating lease contracts with third-party lessees and lease the purchased subject matter in an operating lease model.
